mission.stated: A space-themed educational web game that teaches children the full A–Z letter sounds through adaptive, interactive gameplay (PWA + Android/Capacitor).
mission.actual: Functional A–Z phonics game with Web Audio API sound synthesis, Capacitor packaging, and adaptive difficulty. Overhauled with combo streaks, floating score text, planetary themes, and star ratings.
mission.gap: Curriculum data covered all letters, but visual styling was previously G-centric and gameplay lacked feedback juice. Dependencies had unpatched CVEs in declared package ranges.

dependencies.notes: Declared ^8.5.0 has Critical CVE-2026-103922 (CVSS 9.3). Lockfile has 8.5.1; bump spec in package.json.

dependencies.name: @capacitor/core
dependencies.notes: Declared ^8.5.0 has Critical CVE-2026-103922 (CVSS 9.3). Lockfile has 8.5.1; bump spec in package.json.

dependencies.notes: Transitive undici@7.29.0 has known advisories; override to ^7.30.1

codeQuality.finding: Clean ES module architecture with separated subsystems (audio-manager, event-bus, collision-manager, particles, ui-utils).

architecture.finding: Decoupled pub/sub architecture via EventManager and explicit pair-binding collision detection in CollisionManager.

testing.finding: 154 passing unit, progression, and audio regression tests in Vitest test suite with pairwise-distinct phoneme waveform assertions.

security.finding: Vite and @vitest/mocker development dependencies contain known path traversal and cross-origin execution advisories.

performance.finding: Compositor-only transforms for animations, Web Audio API context suspension on blur, and debounced window resize handling.

documentation.finding: Comprehensive documentation across docs/ directory detailing roadmap, architecture, sound generation, and visual enhancements.

optimality.algorithm: Live Euclidean distance calculation with frame-time clamped delta enables homing asteroids to hit orbiting target planets reliably.
optimality.complexity: Collision detection evaluates registered pairs in O(1) direct lookup, avoiding O(N*M) broadphase loops.
optimality.resources: Procedural Web Audio API sound synthesis requires zero asset downloads and executes on dedicated audio thread.
alternatives: DOM particle element pooling works well up to 100 elements; upgrading to single Canvas2D particle layer recommended for 4K whiteboards.
optimality.scalability: Maintains 60 FPS under continuous multi-touch classroom usage on Android WebViews.

agentFiles.notes: Updated with excitement overhaul and architectural recommendations.
Accurately documents A-Z curriculum scope and PWA status.

externalResearch.finding: Vite 8.2.0, Capacitor 8.5.0, and Vitest 4.1.10 require patch upgrades to clear CVE-2026-112945, CVE-2026-103922, and CVE-2026-84373.

externalResearch.query: early childhood phonics gamification and web audio synthesis
externalResearch.source: W3C Web Audio API Spec & Pediatric UX Research
externalResearch.finding: FM bell synthesis with inharmonic 1.414x ratio and pentatonic scale ensures consonant chimes; grace-period streak shield prevents child disengagement.

externalResearch.query: Capacitor Android WebView and BenQ IFP input performance
externalResearch.source: W3C Pointer Events Level 3 & Chromium GPU Docs
externalResearch.finding: W3C Pointer Events with event.getCoalescedEvents() and { passive: true } listeners provide zero-latency 40-point whiteboard tracking without VRAM layer bloat.

recommendations.title: Security Patch Dependency Manifest & Node Engine
recommendations.why: Protects development servers and native Android packaging against active CVEs in Vite, Capacitor, and Vitest.
recommendations.what: Bump vite to ^8.2.4, @capacitor/* to ^8.5.1, vitest to ^4.1.11, and engines.node to >=22.13.0.

recommendations.title: Grace-Shielded Streak Multiplier & Soft Decay Engine
recommendations.why: Prevents young learners (ages 4-7) from becoming emotionally discouraged by instant zero resets when tapping a distractor planet.
recommendations.what: Implement a 1-hit Streak Shield that absorbs the first incorrect tap, followed by soft multiplier decay (-1x instead of instant reset to 0).
recommendations.source: Tier 2: Pediatric UX Research (Ryan & Deci SDT)

recommendations.title: In-Game Classroom Diagnostic & Telemetry API
recommendations.why: Unlocks real-time teacher observability across classroom tablets or BenQ interactive flat panels without manual JSON downloads.
recommendations.what: Add a REST export/webhook endpoint supporting batch session sync, per-phoneme confusion matrix logging, and an interactive dashboard widget.

recommendations.title: Hardware-Accelerated Canvas2D Particle Engine Upgrade
recommendations.why: DOM element pooling caps particle throughput at ~100 elements before triggering style recalculation drops on 4K BenQ boards.
recommendations.what: Upgrade ParticleSystem in js/particles.js to render bursts, starfield, and debris directly onto a single transparent <canvas> element.
recommendations.interactiveControl: Performance SLA: Locked 60 FPS at 3840x2160 with 1,500 particles
recommendations.source: Tier 1: Chromium Life of a Pixel

recommendations.title: W3C Pointer Events & Coalesced Digitizer Integration
recommendations.why: Maximizes multi-student touch tracking precision on 40-point interactive whiteboards without compositor scroll lag.
recommendations.what: Transition android-benq-init.js from legacy touch events to W3C Pointer Events (pointerdown, pointermove) with event.getCoalescedEvents() and { passive: true }.
